chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Khālid, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥabīb, from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Aṣamm, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Muskān, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

Amīr al-Muʾminīn, ṣalawātullāh ʿalayhi, said: There is no servant except that forty shields are upon him until he commits forty major sins. Then when he commits forty major sins, the shields are uncovered from him, and Allah reveals to them: “Cover My servant with your wings,” so the angels cover him with their wings.

He said: Then he leaves nothing of ugliness except that he commits it, until he boasts before the people of his ugly deed. Then the angels say: “O Lord, this servant of Yours leaves nothing except that he has ridden into it, and we are ashamed of what he does.” So Allah, Mighty and Majestic, reveals to them: “Lift your wings away from him.”

Then when that is done, he begins to hate us, the Ahl al-Bayt. At that point, his covering is torn away in the heaven and his covering in the earth, and the angels say: “O Lord, this servant of Yours has remained with his cover torn away.” So Allah, Mighty and Majestic, reveals to them: “If Allah had any need concerning him, He would not have commanded you to lift your wings away from him.”
And Ibn Faḍḍāl also narrated it from Ibn Muskān.

key_terms.أَجْنِحَتِكُمْ: your wings, by which the angels cover the servant
key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: the People of the Household of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.السِّتْرِ: covering or concealment of one's shame and disgrace
key_terms.الْقَبِيحِ: ugly or vile acts of disobedience
key_terms.الْمَلَائِكَةُ: the angels charged with covering and then withdrawing from the servant
key_terms.بُغْضِنَا: hatred toward us, meaning the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.جُنَّةً: a shield or protective covering placed over the servant

ai.seo_question: How does repeated major sin affect Allah’s covering and protection over a person according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a servant is granted layers of divine covering despite repeated sin, but persistent commission of major sins and open pride in evil lead to the removal of that protection. It further presents hatred of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام as a sign of extreme spiritual ruin and total exposure before Allah.
